# stalwart_user (Resource)

Manages a Stalwart user (the `x:Account` object).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "stalwart_user" "alice" {
  name          = "alice"
  description   = "Alice Example"
  email_address = "alice@example.com"
  domain_id     = stalwart_domain.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the account, typically an email address local part.

### Optional

- `aliases` (Attributes List) List of email aliases for the account (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aliases))
- `description` (String) Description of the account
- `domain_id` (String) Identifier for the domain this account belongs to. This is used to determine the email address of the account, which is formed as name@domain.
- `encryption_at_rest` (Attributes) Encryption-at-rest settings for the account (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--encryption_at_rest))
- `locale` (String) Preferred locale for the account
- `member_group_ids` (Set of String) List of groups that this account is a member of
- `member_tenant_id` (String) Identifier for the tenant this account belongs to
- `permissions` (Attributes) Permissions assigned to this account (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))
- `quotas` (Map of String) Quotas for different object types within this account
- `roles` (Attributes) Roles assigned to this user account (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))
- `time_zone` (String) Preferred time zone for the account

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation date of the account
- `email_address` (String) Email address for the user account, formed as name@domain.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier.
- `used_disk_quota` (Number) Amount of disk space currently used by this account (bytes)

<a id="nestedatt--aliases"></a>
### Nested Schema for `aliases`

Optional:

- `description` (String) Description of the email alias
- `domain_id` (String) Identifier for the domain of the email alias (the part after the @ symbol).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this email alias is enabled
- `name` (String) The local part of the email alias (the part before the @ symbol)


<a id="nestedatt--encryption_at_rest"></a>
### Nested Schema for `encryption_at_rest`

Required:

- `type` (String) Variant discriminator.

Optional:

- `allow_spam_training` (Boolean) Whether to allow training the spam classifier with plaintext emails before encryption
- `encrypt_on_append` (Boolean) Whether to encrypt emails when they are appended to mailboxes
- `public_key` (String) Public key used for encrypting emails


<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Required:

- `type` (String) Variant discriminator.

Optional:

- `disabled_permissions` (Set of String) List of permissions that are explicitly disabled, even if they would be inherited through other roles or groups. This takes precedence over enabled permissions.
- `enabled_permissions` (Set of String) List of permissions that are explicitly enabled.


<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Required:

- `type` (String) Variant discriminator.

Optional:

- `role_ids` (Set of String) List of roles assigned to this principal.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import stalwart_user.example <id>
```
